capability.name: Look-alike name check: mixed scripts, homoglyphs, invisible characters
capability.description: Does this agent, tool, package or domain name pretend to be another? Flags Latin mixed with Cyrillic or Greek, whole-script look-alikes, names whose UTS #39 skeleton equals one you protect, zero-width, tag and bidi characters (Trojan Source), fullwidth and mathematical letters, and punycode domains (decoded). Says 'looks like', never 'is malicious'.

note: registry hygiene: catches the paypal-with-a-Cyrillic-a class of spoof
